overall: The AG found the Holland Board of Selectmen violated the Open Meeting Law by reconvening and deliberating after adjourning its properly noticed September 3, 2013 meeting. No additional relief was ordered because the Board acknowledged the violation and rescinded the appointment, then reconsidered it after proper notice on November 5, 2013.

allegations.summary: Board reconvened its adjourned Sept. 3, 2013 meeting to consider an appointment without posting new notice, after the broadcast had ended.
allegations.key_passage: Because the adjournment of the Board's September 3, 2013 meeting indicated to the public that no further deliberation would occur on that date, the Board violated the Open Meeting Law by continuing its discussion after that time.
